transcript: If you wake up tired no matter how long you sleep, if your mind feels foggy, your body heavy, and your motivation fading, this is not laziness. This is your body whispering that it can't keep running on empty. And it's probably what the West now calls chronic fatigue syndrome. In America, I see so many souls living on caffeine, screens, and stress. The body never truly rests. The mind never goes silent. Your system becomes trapped in survival mode. Too much cortisol. Too little restoration. The nervous system forgets how to relax. So you wake up exhausted, even after eight hours of sleep. But nature still remembers how to heal you. Start simple. Ground your body in sunlight. Eat warm, real food. Not factory-made energy. Breathe slower. Sleep before midnight. And rest your mind as often as your body. When you calm the fire of stress, energy begins to return naturally. The fog clears. The heaviness lifts. And you start to feel human again. If you're from the U.S. or any Western country, comment below. And if you wish to learn more about restoring natural energy and balance, you can find my healing e-book in the link on my profile.
